Satisfy most of your daily needs. Whether at home or on the go.

With "Reading Mode" it can reduce harmful light to the eyes and you get to enjoy a comfortable experience when reading and watching video.

【Performance Tablets】 This tablet 7 inch is equipped with a high-performance quad-core processor. 1.6Ghz frequency. Ensures faster app launches, offers you a quick and fluent experience for entertainment. In addition, Tablet support latest wifi 6 module. You can connect to the internet faster and the connection is stable. Smoother loading of web pages and applications.
